narration.full_text: Namaste students! Today, we're diving into the fascinating world of animal control and coordination, focusing specifically on the endocrine system. We'll explore how organisms regulate their activities and respond to stimuli. Control and coordination is the essential process by which an organism regulates and integrates its various activities to respond effectively to both internal and external stimuli. Living organisms constantly perform multiple activities that need to be controlled and coordinated to maintain balance and ensure survival. All living organisms react and respond to changes in their surrounding environment. These environmental changes, which trigger a response from organisms, are known as stimuli. Examples include light, heat, cold, smell, and touch. While both plants and animals respond to stimuli, they do so in different ways.
